overview_description.description:
Zolve is a neo-banking platform that provides financial products to consumers. Its services offers include deposit accounts, prepaid cards, money transfers, bill payments, and cross-border transactions. It also provides tools for monitoring transactions and expense and budget management.

It was launched in 2020 and is based in Bangalore, India.

about_short_description.short_description: Zolve is a neo-banking platform that provides financial products to consumers.

product.name: Zolve USA Credit Card
product.description: A credit card designed for international students and immigrants in the USA that does not require a Social Security Number (SSN) or US credit history to apply.

product.name: Zolve USA Checking Account
product.description: An online checking account for international students and immigrants in the USA that can be opened before arrival without an SSN.

product.name: Zolve International Money Transfer
product.description: A service enabling fast, low-cost international money transfers between the US and India with transparent fees and competitive exchange rates.

product.name: Zolve Education Loan
product.description: A loan product designed to help international students finance their education abroad, covering tuition and living expenses.

product.name: Zolve Virtual Card
product.description: A virtual credit or debit card linked to the Zolve account for cashless digital transactions and mobile wallet integration.

product.name: Zolve Azpire Credit Builder Card
product.description: A secured credit card with no minimum deposit and no interest, designed to help users build or rebuild credit history in the US.
